q: How much husk and power do Burdwan's rice mills use per tonne of rice?
title: Burdwan rice mills: husk and power per tonne
short: Burdwan's 500 or so mills burnt about 2.03 million t of husk and used 773 million kWh in 2024-25 to turn 11.3 million t of paddy into 7.27 million t of rice. That is about 0.28 t of husk and 106 kWh per tonne of rice, with grid power carrying the fossil CO2.
audience: Parboiled, pressure parboiled, raw and scented rice mills in the Burdwan cluster

ul: About 275 parboiled mills, 75 pressure parboiled, 75 scented and 75 de-husking units making raw rice.
200 large mills above 70 t of paddy a day process 7.2 million t; 150 medium and 150 small mills the rest.
De-husking units use only electricity; parboiling mills need steam for soaking and drying.

sections.h: Husk: your fuel and your by-product
p: Husk gives about 90% of a parboiling mill's energy, electricity 10%. Mills typically burn 85% of their own husk and sell the rest, at about Rs 2,200 a tonne. Mills with old boilers buy extra husk. Husk CO2 is biogenic and reported separately; methane and nitrous oxide from burning it do count in Scope 1.

ul: Large: 6,468 t husk and 2,596,841 kWh a year.
A parboiled unit uses 0.058 to 0.061 toe per tonne.

p: Replace old single pass boilers with efficient IBR boilers: they lose heat through open charging doors, bare surfaces and hot flue gas with no waste heat recovery. Husk saved can be sold, and kWh saved cuts the fossil figure a rice buyer sees.

example.title: Per tonne of rice (estimate)
lines: Husk: 2.025 million t / 7.27 million t rice = 0.28 t per tonne
Power: 773 million kWh / 7.27 million t = 106 kWh per tonne
Fossil CO2: 106 x 0.675 = 72 kg per tonne of rice (46 kg per tonne of paddy)
Large mill: 2,596,841 kWh x 0.675 = 1,753 t CO2 a year
Cluster husk: about 2.46 million t CO2, reported as biogenic
example.note: From TERI's 2024-25 Burdwan energy profile. Husk CO2 uses the profile's energy figure with the IPCC default of 100 kg CO2 per GJ for solid biomass.

senseible: Senseible reads your electricity bills and husk purchase or sale bills into one record, with husk on its own biogenic line, so your carbon number per tonne holds up.
